12:44.text: They said: "Mixed up false dreams and we are not skilled in the interpretation of dreams."

12:45.text: Then the man who was released
(one of the two who were in prison)
, now at length remembered and said: "I will tell you its interpretation, so send me forth."

12:46.text: , the man of truth! Explain to us
of seven fat cows whom seven lean ones were devouring, and of seven green ears of corn, and
others dry, that I may return to the people, and that they may know."

12:47.text: said: "For seven consecutive years, you shall sow as usual and that
which you reap you shall leave it in the ears,
except a little of it which you may eat.

12:48.text: "Then will come after that, seven hard
, which will devour what you have laid by in advance for them,
except a little of that which you have guarded

12:49.text: "Then thereafter will come a year in which people will have abundant rain and in which they will press

12:50.text: And the king said: "Bring him to me." But when the messenger came to him,
said: "Return to your lord and ask him, ‘What happened to the women who cut their hands? Surely, my Lord

12:51.text: : "What was your affair when you did seek to seduce Yûsuf
?" The women said: "Allâh forbid! No evil know we against him!" The wife of Al-‘Azîz said: "Now the truth is manifest
; it was I who sought to seduce him, and he is surely of the truthful."

12:52.text: [Then Yûsuf (Joseph) said: "I asked for this enquiry]
may know that I betrayed him not in
absence". And, verily! Allâh guides not the plot of the betrayers.
